page_text_ocr_zh:
聆听故事、培养品德

发现孩子有了行为偏差，家长谁不想立即加以导正。

但是用什么方法？这一套书设计的是“看图听故事”的方法——不打、不骂、不惩罚。

编者采用有趣的“图画故事”形式，为孩子讲一个故事，提供一种情境，
让孩子“在故事里走了一趟”以后，根据所见所闻，透过客观讨论，认识
行为对自己和对别人的影响。

这些故事只提供情境，跟一般的“说教故事”不同。

编者期待的是家长能善用这一套书，导正孩子的行为偏差——不仅是“导正”，更重要的是“建立”理性的行为标准。

我对编者的创意和用心，表达钦佩。

台湾著名儿童文学作家
林良
page_text_en:
Listening to Stories, Cultivating Virtues

When children show behavioral problems, who wouldn't want parents to correct them immediately?

But what method should be used? This series is designed with the "picture-story listening" approach — no hitting, no scolding, no punishment.

The editors use an engaging "picture story" format to tell a story for children, providing a scenario. After children "take a walk through the story," they reflect on what they've seen and heard, and through objective discussion, understand how their behavior affects themselves and others.

These stories only provide scenarios, different from typical "didactic stories".

The editors hope parents will make good use of this series to correct children's behavioral issues — not just "correcting," but more importantly, "establishing" rational behavioral standards.

I express my admiration for the editors' creativity and dedication.

Famous Taiwanese children's literature writer
Lin Liang

page_text_ocr_zh:
小故事大启发

“一日之计在于晨”，小豆豆在奶奶的呼唤下，精神抖擞，准备迎接充实美好的一天。每个人一天都有相同的24小时，所以充分利用时间是很重要的。豆豆每天都有例行的事要做：和爷爷一起到森林里叫大家起床；中午的时候，全家外出野餐；等睡过了午觉，就是豆豆最喜欢的自由活动时间了。

太阳下山了，一天结束了，豆豆又过了好充实的一天，时间一点儿都没有随便浪费掉。

麻雀给人的印象是最早起、最有精神的小动物了，因此这个故事借由小麻雀豆豆的一天来表现时间的概念。豆豆每天都要做的一切，就如同小朋友要上学、上课，爸爸妈妈要上班一样。每个人必须在不同的时间内做该做的事，除了这些事之外，属于个人的时间更要善于利用，因此豆豆在这段时间里自我调配，做自己喜欢做的事，充实自己，或找好朋友一起做游戏，好好玩一玩。

这个故事不仅表现出时间的概念，也让我们了解到善于利用时间的重要。
page_text_en:
Little Stories, Big Inspirations

"The planning of a day begins at dawn." Under Grandma's call, Little DouDou is full of energy, ready to welcome a fulfilling and wonderful day. Everyone has the same 24 hours in a day, so making good use of time is very important. DouDou has routine tasks every day: waking everyone up in the forest with Grandpa; having a family picnic at noon; and after a nap, it's DouDou's favorite free time.

The sun sets, the day ends, and DouDou has had another fulfilling day, with not a single moment wasted.

Sparrows are often seen as the earliest risers and most energetic little animals. Therefore, this story uses the day of little sparrow DouDou to illustrate the concept of time. Everything DouDou does every day is just like how children go to school and have classes, and how parents go to work. Everyone must do what they should do within different time periods. Besides these tasks, personal time should be used wisely. Therefore, DouDou uses this time to self-arrange, doing things he likes, enriching himself, or playing games with good friends, having a good time.

This story not only expresses the concept of time, but also helps us understand the importance of using time wisely.
summary_zh: 本页为绘本的总结页，通过小麻雀豆豆一天的活动，阐述了时间管理的重要性，强调了在完成日常任务的同时，也要善于利用个人时间做喜欢的事情。
